Senses.Explanation: A lineage master: the designation for someone presented or judged in relation to the Chan ancestral line. The term occurs 1,445 times in 257 allowlisted texts. Daowu Wuzhen gives a direct role statement: “As for a lineage master, he takes away the poor child's pearl sewn in his clothes and examines the accomplished person's viewpoint” (夫宗師者，奪貧子之衣珠，究達人之見處). Dahui Zonggao says that a lineage master decides right and wrong and must open people's eyes rather than rely only on blind cangues and sightless blows (大凡宗師決斷是非。要得開人眼目。不可一向盲枷瞎棒). Zhaozhou Congshen says a lineage master must meet people with the fundamental matter. Yuanwu Keqin likewise says the lineage-master household must teach a person through, even at the cost of injuring hand and blade when the person does not understand (宗師家為人須為教徹). Yuanwu calls Zhaozhou Congshen “a great-handed lineage master” (大手宗師), saying that Zhaozhou does not discuss mystery, marvel, occasion, or object but meets people with the fundamental matter. He also calls Dongshan Shouchu, Zhimen Guangzuo, Deshan Yuanming, and Xianglin Chengyuan “great lineage masters” (皆為大宗師). The label can be withheld or mocked: Xuedou Chongxian says of an inadequate answer, “calling oneself a lineage master like this and wanting to open the eyes of humans and gods—only in the donkey year” (如此自稱宗師，欲開人天眼目，驢年去). The noun thus works as a title and appraisal tied to public responsibilities, and as a rebuke when a claimant does not meet them.
Senses.Note: All direct-definition formulas and common modifiers were searched. The “great lineage master” form occurs 113 times in 49 texts; the lineage-master-household form occurs 87 times in 47; the lineage-master-eye form occurs 22 times in 20; and the “lineage master of a generation” form occurs nine times in eight. The role is corpus-wide and is not keyed to a single teacher.

Occurrences.Kwic: 夫宗師者，奪貧子之衣珠，究達人之見處。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Guidelines of the Patriarchs (列祖提綱錄), Daowu Wuzhen's sequence of hall addresses: Daowu Wuzhen defines a lineage master as taking the poor son's robe-jewel and examining an accomplished person's standpoint.

Occurrences.Kwic: 大凡宗師決斷是非。要得開人眼目。不可一向盲枷瞎棒。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dahui Pujue (大慧普覺禪師語錄): Dahui Zonggao states that lineage masters decide right and wrong and open people's eyes, then rejects relying solely on blind blows.

Occurrences.Kwic: 此是大手宗師。不與爾論玄論妙。論機論境。一向以本分事接人。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text; exact headword utterer: Yuanwu Keqin. Complete-case evidence: Yuanwu calls Zhaozhou a 大手宗師 in his commentary.

Occurrences.Kwic: 後出四哲。乃洞山初。智門寬。德山密。香林遠皆為大宗師。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text; exact headword utterer: Yuanwu Keqin. Complete-case evidence: Yuanwu names Yunmen’s four heirs and calls all four 大宗師.

Occurrences.Kwic: 如此自稱宗師，欲開人天眼目，驢年去。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Collected Old Cases Raised in the Lineage (宗門拈古彙集), Baizhang Huaihai section. Xuedou Chongxian is the exact later commentator who uses the title in a rebuke of someone claiming it without an adequate answer.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若是宗師湏以本分事接人始得
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text; exact headword utterer: Zhaozhou Congshen. Complete-case evidence: Zhaozhou quotes Guishan’s reply, then himself says 若是宗師須以本分事接人始得.

Occurrences.Kwic: 宗師家為人須為教徹。見他不會。不免傷鋒犯手。只要教他明此事。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text; exact headword utterer: Yuanwu Keqin. Complete-case evidence: Yuanwu comments on Mazu’s handling of Baizhang and says 宗師家 must teach a person through.
